label.description: Label rendered above (or beside, for binary controls) the input.

description.description: Helper text rendered below the input. Hidden when `error` is set.

anyOf.description: Library-level extension of the standard `Error` type. Frappe's whitelisted methods may return an error with multiple messages on `messages?: string[]`. This is the shape input components render in their error region.

error.description: Error message rendered below the input. When set, the control receives `aria-invalid="true"` and `data-state="invalid"`. May be either a string or an `Error` object whose `messages?: string[]` is rendered as stacked lines (with `Error.message` as the fallback).

required.description: Marks the field as required. Renders an asterisk next to the label and forwards `required` / `aria-required` to the underlying control.

id.description: HTML id of the underlying control. Auto-generated via `useId()` if omitted.

variant.description: Visual style of the select input.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text displayed when no option is selected.

disabled.description: If true, disables the select input.

open.description: Controls the visibility of the select menu.

options.description: Options to display in the dropdown.

emptyText.description: Fallback empty-state copy rendered when no options are available.

label.description: Overrides the rendered label content. Receives `{ required }`.

prefix.description: Content rendered before the trigger value. Receives the same shape as `#trigger` and `#suffix` (`SelectSlotProps`).

suffix.description:
Content rendered after the trigger value. Providing this slot
**replaces the default chevron** — render your own fallback when your slot content is conditional.

option.deprecated: use `#item-label` for per-row label customization. `#option` remains as a back-compat alias through v1.x.

item-prefix.description: Content rendered before the standard option label.

item-label.description: Content rendered for the standard option label area.

item-suffix.description: Content rendered after the standard option label.

empty.description: Fallback content rendered when no options are available.

footer.description: Content rendered below the option list. Stays pinned below the scrollable options.

update:modelValue.description: Fired when the selected value changes.

update:open.description: Fired when the open state changes.
